items.title: With AI, researchers discover new way to detect sudden cardiac death risk
items.raw_excerpt: A UC Berkeley-led project trained an AI system on hundreds of thousands of EKGs. The resulting risk predictions are much better than existing methods, paving the way to save lives at scale.

title_i18n.en: With AI, researchers discover new way to detect sudden cardiac death risk
title_i18n.zh: 借助人工智能，研究人员发现检测心源性猝死风险的新方法
title_i18n.es: Con la IA, los investigadores descubren una nueva forma de detectar el riesgo de muerte súbita cardíaca

excerpt_i18n.en: A UC Berkeley-led project trained an AI system on hundreds of thousands of EKGs. The resulting risk predictions are much better than existing methods, paving the way to save lives at scale.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一个由加州大学伯克利分校领导的项目在数十万份心电图数据上训练了一个人工智能系统。由此产生的风险预测远优于现有方法，为大规模拯救生命铺平了道路。
excerpt_i18n.es: Un proyecto liderado por UC Berkeley entrenó un sistema de IA con cientos de miles de electrocardiogramas. Las predicciones de riesgo resultantes son mucho mejores que los métodos existentes, allanando el camino para salvar vidas a gran escala.

items.title: 2027 Macs to Get AI-Focused M7 Chips as Apple Skips High-End M6
items.raw_excerpt: Apple is changing its Apple silicon launch timeline to speed up the debut of chips designed for artificial intelligence workloads, reports Bloomberg. Apple plans to release an M6 chip for entry-level Macs as soon as this year, but it has canceled plans for higher-end M6 Pro and M6 Max chips. Instead, Apple's next Pro and Max chips will be part of its M7 chip lineup, with the first M7 chips launching in 2027. An M5 Ultra chip could also come as soon as this year.
